capabilities: Render the whole vault as a disc with one wedge per top-level folder
Filter and search the graph by folder, tags, and query
Scrub a date ribbon to watch vault growth as a heatmap and timeline
Colour, show, and hide folders, including unlinked-note grouping
Export the graph as a single self-contained offline HTML file
extras: The exported HTML contains note titles, paths, tags, dates and the link graph (not bodies), so the README warns to treat it as private. Releases carry GitHub build provenance attestations; the plugin makes zero network requests. Some helper scripts are Windows-only.
intentEvidence: Deterministic, not force-directed - the same vault always draws the same picture
problem: Obsidian's force-directed graph view rearranges on every open and tangles everything together, so the vault's overall shape is hard to learn and recognise over time.

relations.evidence: the renderer is a port of Sigma.js 3.0.2 under MIT

summary: Deterministic disc graph of the whole vault: notes packed into folder wedges, sized by links, with a growth heatmap, timeline, and standalone HTML export.
